```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
first_record <- 2010L
first_season <- 2013L
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
fbs_seasons <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(
    classification == "fbs",
    season >= first_record,
    season <= last_season
  ) |>
  collect()
credited <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |>
  filter(
    season >= first_season,
    season <= last_season,
    tier_label != "FCS and below"
  ) |>
  collect()
teams <- tbl(con, "teams") |> collect()
team_colors <- team_color_values(teams)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
#| output: false
school <- school_record(fbs_seasons, credited)
ranked <- school |>
  group_by(tier) |>
  arrange(desc(above), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(rank_over = row_number(), rank_under = rev(row_number())) |>
  ungroup()
over <- filter(ranked, rank_over <= 5L)
under <- filter(ranked, rank_under <= 5L)
# The schools the card highlights: the two Power schools furthest above and
# the two furthest below, and the top Group of 5 school above expectation.
top_power <- filter(over, tier == "Power") |> slice_max(above, n = 2) |> pull(team)
bottom_power <- filter(under, tier == "Power") |> slice_min(above, n = 2) |> pull(team)
top_g5 <- filter(over, tier == "Group of 5") |> slice_max(above, n = 1) |> pull(team)
named <- c(top_power, bottom_power, top_g5)
school$tip <- paste0(
  school$team,
  " (",
  school$tier,
  ")\nRecord 2010 to 2025: ",
  school$record_label,
  "; ",
  school$drafted,
  " drafted of ",
  school$eligible,
  " eligible; ",
  sprintf("%.1f", school$expected),
  " expected"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
bars <- bind_rows(over, under) |>
  left_join(select(school, team, tier, tip), by = c("team", "tier")) |>
  mutate(
    key = paste(tier, team, sep = "___"),
    shade = if_else(team %in% named, "Highlighted", "Other")
  )
p <- ggplot(bars, aes(above, reorder(key, above), fill = shade)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = team),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#111827", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~tier, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(".*___", "", x)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Highlighted = "#374151", Other = "#d1d5db"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Drafted minus expected for the record",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Drafted minus expected for the top five schools above and below in each tier",
    subtitle = "Five furthest over and under in each tier; highlighted schools in dark grey",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "over-under-producers", release = release, height = 8)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 9)
```

```{r}
#| label: explore
p_explore <- ggplot(school, aes(expected, drafted)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#6b7280") +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(fill = team, tooltip = tip, data_id = team),
    shape = 21,
    size = 4.2,
    color = "white",
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~tier, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = highlight_colors(team_colors), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Expected draftees for the record",
    y = "Drafted",
    title = "Every school's draftees against its record's prediction",
    subtitle = "Above the dashed line: more draftees than expected; hover a dot for counts",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_explore, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 8)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
bind_rows(over, under) |>
  arrange(tier, desc(above)) |>
  transmute(
    Tier = tier,
    School = team,
    `Record 2010 to 2025` = record_label,
    `Win %` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * win_pct),
    `Eligible players` = eligible,
    Drafted = drafted,
    Expected = sprintf("%.1f", expected),
    `Drafted minus expected` = sprintf("%+.1f", above)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Tier", "School", "Record 2010 to 2025", "Win %", "Eligible players",
      "Drafted", "Expected", "Drafted minus expected"
    ),
    caption = "The five schools in each tier with the most draftees above and below the number expected for their record, final seasons 2013 to 2025. Expected draftees come from the tier's win curve applied to the school's eligible players."
  )
```
